title: Kissed by Tadka Mexican Chocolate Pudding
description: A rich, creamy Mexican dessert made with milk chocolate, tadka, and a touch of cinnamon, perfect for a special treat.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the heavy cream, whole milk, granulated sugar, and ground cinnamon. Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
In a separate saucepan, melt the dark chocolate chips over low heat, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and a splash of the warm milk mixture until smooth.
Add the melted chocolate, tadka spice blend, and vanilla extract to the milk mixture. Whisk constantly to prevent lumps.
Return the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until thickened.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the butter and whisked cornstarch mixture until melted and smooth.
Strain the pudding through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl to remove any lumps or air bubbles.
Whisk in the egg until well combined.
Pour the pudding into 6-8 individual ramekins or a large cazuela.
Cover the ramekins with plastic wrap, pressing the wrap directly onto the surface of the pudding to prevent a skin from forming.
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of ground cinnamon or a drizzle of chocolate sauce if desired.
